ننكسف (form VII)
# نَنْكَسِفُ (nankasifu) /nan.ka.si.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْكَسَفَ (inkasafa)
# نَنْكَسِفَ (nankasifa) /nan.ka.si.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَسَفَ (inkasafa)
# نَنْكَسِفْ (nankasif) /nan.ka.sif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْكَسَفَ (inkasafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
